payload.central_claim_under_test: the shared route proposal law plus online FiberControl can enter and recursively refine PARP1 seed-0 when the route lane bounds each candidate realization and guarantees a first-round large-program quota
payload.claim_boundary: one fresh answer-known development cell using the same shared checkpoint and controller; only the per-candidate route timeout and first-round scale allocation differ; all 49 calls are prospective and no prior score or endpoint enters runtime
payload.experimental_setting: fresh PARP1 seed-0 delta=0.6 shared-controller run; fixed 49-call full horizon; no prior checkpoint migration, endpoint injection, answer lookup, retry or backfill
payload.forbidden_changes: no endpoint injection, cell-to-route lookup, teacher replay, executor change, endpoint-gate change, FiberControl feature or fit change, parent/archive change, altered batch or exploration, retries, replacement or backfill
payload.primary_baselines: measured fresh root, immutable prior PARP1 shared-controller campaign, and reported IVG seed-0 mean; no comparator enters runtime
payload.primary_model_output: target-reward-adapted selection over shallow, anchored and scale-balanced shared retained-subgraph rewrite programs from a fresh PARP1 seed-0 run

route_complete_region.training_scope: one shared task-independent expert fit on all 77 locked routes

reported_ivg_source.evidence: published lead-optimization table, not a recomputation from released per-seed CSV rows
reported_ivg_source.known_upstream_discrepancy: the released CSV-derived run means differ from the published README table; headline comparison uses the published table and records the discrepancy rather than silently substituting the recomputation

payload.scientific_problem: test whether the primary shared COMPOSE controller can recover the PARP1 seed-0 high-utility regime when each route realization is time-bounded instead of allowing one candidate to prevent publication of the complete pool

zero_oracle_support.claim_boundary: this contract bounds per-candidate runtime and fixes first-round allocation; it does not claim autonomous utility before prospective scoring
zero_oracle_support.requirement: the unchanged shared checkpoint must emit exact committed small, medium and large route programs from the PARP1 seed-0 root under maximum_expansions=4000 and per_candidate_timeout_seconds=10.0; every timed-out realization is an explicit abstention and no teacher endpoint may be injected
